description: This is a test class for the ConceptDatatypeEditor, part of the OpenMRS project. It tests the behavior of the ConceptDatatypeEditor class, which appears to handle property editing for ConceptDatatype objects within the OpenMRS framework. The file includes a test setup that retrieves a ConceptDatatype via the ConceptService, using a predefined ID.

classes.name: ConceptDatatypeEditorTest
classes.description: Test class for the ConceptDatatypeEditor property editor, extending a base test class and verifying the retrieval of ConceptDatatype instances.

methods.name: getNewEditor
methods.description: Creates a new instance of ConceptDatatypeEditor for the test.

methods.name: getExistingObject
methods.description: Retrieves an existing ConceptDatatype object using the conceptService and a predefined ID.
